project: GUTTERCAPS · NIGHT MOTH · The Wall Remembers

district.name: Night Moth
district.rule: No locations, heroes or palette accents from other districts

visual_style: Stylized GUTTERCAPS stencil-noir screen-print illustration: asphalt charcoal #16151A–#2A2830, cyan #16E5D9, rare sodium amber; angular shadow shapes, hand-painted brick and metal, distressed stencil edges, restrained halftone and spray grain. Natural proportions. No letterbox, black bars, border or baked titles.
story: In the Old Industrial Quarter, Moth paints an anonymous stencil mural on a new-moon night. The city buffs it by morning, but local Keepers preserve the image.

frames.title: New Moon
frames.beat: Moth enters the Old Industrial Quarter and approaches a blank warehouse wall.
frames.camera: Slow vertical crane down through rooftops to the full-body figure and wet pavement.
layers: warehouse roofs, chimneys and crescent moon
frames.transition: Follow Moth toward the blank wall.

frames.title: The Wall
frames.beat: Moth examines buffed paint ghosts left on the same warehouse wall.
frames.camera: Over-shoulder push-in; rack focus from the glove to old paint layers.
frames.transition: Match the empty wall to the cut-paper stencil.

frames.title: The Stencil
frames.beat: In the warehouse boiler room, Moth unfolds a moth carrying a tiny briefcase stencil.
frames.camera: Table-height diagonal close-to-medium shot; focus hands, stencil, then eyes.
layers: boiler, pipes and cyan work light
frames.transition: Cut on the stencil silhouette to the ladder rails.

frames.title: The Climb
frames.beat: Moth carries the stencil kit up the warehouse service ladder.
frames.camera: Low-angle tilt upward, holding the whole figure and ladder in frame.
frames.sfx: metal ladder creak, boots on rungs
frames.transition: Tilt to the wall at the maintenance platform.

frames.title: First Coat
frames.beat: The first controlled cyan pass lands on the wall.
frames.camera: Slow side dolly; aerosol briefly crosses the lens.
frames.transition: Spray mist wipes into the rain.

frames.title: Second Rain
frames.beat: Moth peels the stencil away and reveals the complete cyan moth image.
frames.camera: Track the stencil edge, then rack focus to the wall and Moth's eyes.
frames.transition: A wet reflection leads toward the Keepers' camera.

frames.title: The Keepers
frames.beat: Two local Keepers document the mural while Moth watches from the catwalk.
frames.camera: Low over-shoulder composition; one flash, then focus on the photo.
layers: Moth on the catwalk and warehouse
frames.transition: Flash match-cut to early-morning wash lights.

frames.title: The Buff
frames.beat: An unmarked city wash truck erases the mural; Keepers protect the photograph; Moth does not confront the crew.
frames.camera: Lateral move through falling water; the cyan image fades to a ghost outline.
layers: plain wash truck and warehouse depth
frames.sfx: water pump, wash spray, low motor

frames.title: The Archive
frames.beat: The Keepers pin the saved photograph among earlier abstract moth images in a hidden room beneath the same warehouse.
frames.camera: Slow move through the doorway; settle focus on the new photograph.
frames.transition: Match the photograph's cyan moth to the image on a camera screen.

frames.title: The Wall Remembers
frames.beat: The real wall is nearly blank, but the Keeper's camera preserves the mural; Moth watches the Quarter wake.
frames.camera: Pull back from the saved photo to the ghost mark, Moth, and the dawn rooftops.
layers: water tower, chimneys and pale morning sky
frames.transition: Hold for an editorial title card; do not bake text into the artwork.
